desc: Derive the complete directed-edge rerooting DP recurrence, including precise message semantics, invalid-case handling, and the formula for computing each outgoing message by excluding one neighbor.
Design an iterative rooting/postorder traversal and top-down reroot pass suitable for \(N \le 2\times10^5\).
Verify the top-level recurrence requiring exactly four neighboring branch contributions and the requirement of at least one degree-4 vertex.
Implement the algorithm in Python with adjacency lists and efficient extraction of the largest three/four neighbor DP values.
